title: Jab gire ran me baawafa abbas
body:
Jab gire ran me baawafa abbas
sadre zee'n se hue juda abbas
girte girte ye di sada abbas
ho gaya aap par fida abbas
<<MINI>>
Aao ya shaahe karbala aao
gurz se shaq hai sar mera aao
<<DIVIDER>>
Aayi jis dam furaat se ye sada
Sun ke bataab ho gaye moula
ali akbar ne baap se ye kaha
chaliye baba pukaarte hai chacha
<<MINI>>
keh ke akbar ba shoro shain chale
Dil ko thaame hue hussain chale
<<DIVIDER>>
Peet'te the hussain seena o sar
The sambhaale hue ali akbar
ab jo pohnche furaat par sarwar ki nigaah bhai ke jo laashe par
Paaenti the khade hue shabbir
dil bhar aaya to ro diye shabbir
<<DIVIDER>>
choor zaqmo'n se tha ali ka pisar
jaa'n balab hai jari uthe kyu kar
tab kaha shaah se ye ro ro kar
dekhiye mai pada hu'n reti par
<<MINI>>
ho bahel ye meri qata aaqa
aap hai hujjate quda aaqa
<<DIVIDER>>
Ye wasiyat hai aap se aaqa
qaimagaah me na laash le jaana
hoga sab bibiyo'n ka haal bura
royegi mujh ko saaniye zahra
<<MINI>>
mera madfan yaha'n mudaam rahe
hashr tak bas yahi ghulaam rahe
<<DIVIDER>>
waqte aaqir yahi malaal raha
hai sakina ko intezaar mera
tha ye iqraar paani laane ka
mai pada hu yaha'n labe darya
<<MINI>>
Kehti hogi ab aayenge ammu
Hum ko paani pilaayenge ammu
<<DIVIDER>>
sar se amaama sheh ne phaink diya
apni tooti kamar ko thaam liya
kehte the kya ghazab hua bhaiyya
tum ne ghurbat me saath chord diya
<<MINI>>
reth par so rahe ho kya bhai
uth ke bhai ko do sada bhai
<<DIVIDER>>
phir alamdar se ye sheh ne kaha
zindagi bhar pukaare tum aaqa
aaj ye chaahta hai dil mera
Bhai mujhko pukaaro behre khuda
<<MINI>>
Sunke irshaade shaahe behrobar
Bhai bhai kaha Ali ka pisar
<<DIVIDER>>
keh ke bhai laraz gaya jarraar
jism sab sard ho gaya ek baar
di ye aawaz yaa shahe abraar
qalq se jaa raha hai ye ghamqaar
<<MINI>>
aye qateele jafa khudahafiz
Aye shahe karbala khudahafiz
<<DIVIDER>>
Bhai ka dam jo saamne nikla
roye sar peet kar shahe waala
mud ke kadyal jawaan se ye kaha
le chalo mashk aur alam beta
<<MINI>>
ham ko be aas kar gaye abbas
mar gaye aah mar gaye abbas
